lines.zh: 我走过长厅，地毯吸掉我的脚步。
lines.en: I cross the hall, the carpet swallowing my steps.

lines.zh: 我的披风拖过石阶，像一道黑水。
lines.en: My cape drags down the stairs like black water.

lines.zh: 我绕着血池走，池面映出我的脸。
lines.en: I circle the blood pool, which mirrors my face.

lines.zh: 我走到城堡的窗口，看村里的灯。
lines.en: I go to the castle window and watch village lights.

lines.zh: 我踩过骷髅，它们是我从前的仆人。
lines.en: I step over skulls, once my servants.

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊走，蝙蝠在梁上让路。
lines.en: I walk the corridor, and the bats clear the beams.

lines.zh: 我下到地窖，那里存着九桶血。
lines.en: I descend to the cellar where nine barrels of blood wait.

lines.zh: 我在石板上走，脚步声像别人的。
lines.en: I cross the flagstones with footsteps that sound like another's.

lines.zh: 我穿过墓园，草木都低了头。
lines.en: I cross the graveyard, and the grass bows down.

lines.zh: 我走向王座，那里一直没有别人坐。
lines.en: I walk toward the throne that no one else has sat in.

lines.zh: 我坐在高背椅上，指尖敲着扶手。
lines.en: I sit in the high chair, tapping the armrest.

lines.zh: 我摇晃杯里的血，看它挂在杯壁上。
lines.en: I swirl the blood in my cup and watch it cling.

lines.zh: 我数着城堡里的蝙蝠，少了两只。
lines.en: I count the castle bats; two are missing.

lines.zh: 我让仆人把窗帘拉严，一丝光都不留。
lines.en: I have the servants seal the curtains against every sliver of light.

lines.zh: 我在看那面旧镜子，里面没有我。
lines.en: I study the old mirror, which holds no reflection.

lines.zh: 我把戒指转了半圈，银会烫手。
lines.en: I turn my ring half a turn; silver would burn.

lines.zh: 我在听地窖的血滴声，很有节奏。
lines.en: I listen to blood dripping in the cellar, steady as a pulse.

lines.zh: 我把一颗尖牙放在桌上，它已经发黄。
lines.en: I set a fang on the table; it has yellowed.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的岁数，数到一半就停了。
lines.en: I count my years and stop halfway.

lines.zh: 我摸披风上的血渍，那是三百年前的。
lines.en: I touch a stain on my cape; it is three centuries old.

lines.zh: 我让一只蝙蝠停在手腕上。
lines.en: I let a bat settle on my wrist.

lines.zh: 我把地图摊开，村庄被圈了三次。
lines.en: I unroll the map; the village is circled three times.

lines.zh: 我试着站起来，又坐回去。
lines.en: I try to rise, then settle back down.

lines.zh: 我在等雾，雾会让村子安静。
lines.en: I wait for fog; it will quiet the village.

lines.zh: 我把窗帘掀开一指宽，又放下。
lines.en: I lift the curtain a finger's width, then let it fall.

lines.zh: 我数着地窖里还剩几桶血。
lines.en: I count how many barrels of blood are left.

lines.zh: 你走进我的厅，还带着体温。
lines.en: You walk into my hall still carrying warmth.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有猎人的味道。
lines.en: I smell hunter on you.

lines.zh: 抬头看我，别盯着我的杯子。
lines.en: Look up at me, not at my cup.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太响，整座城堡都听见了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is so loud the whole castle hears it.

lines.zh: 你腰间那把剑，砍过我的同类。
lines.en: That blade at your hip has cut my kin.

lines.zh: 你想谈条件？先把手套摘了。
lines.en: You want terms? Take off your gloves first.

lines.zh: 你不怕我，这让我有点兴趣。
lines.en: You do not fear me, which interests me slightly.

lines.zh: 你的血很干净，不像村里那些人。
lines.en: Your blood is clean, unlike the villagers'.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你最好说点什么。
lines.en: I count to three; you had better say something.

lines.zh: 你站在门口，影子却被我踩着。
lines.en: You stand at the door, yet I stand on your shadow.

lines.zh: 我这里缺一个端杯子的仆人。
lines.en: I am short one servant to carry my cup.

lines.zh: 你的护符很旧，猎人早就不做了。
lines.en: Your amulet is old; the hunters stopped making those.

lines.zh: 你居然划破了我的披风。
lines.en: You actually tore my cape.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起当年的叛乱。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the old rebellion.

lines.zh: 我的血滴在石板上，很快就干了。
lines.en: My blood drips on the stones and dries fast.

lines.zh: 银烧穿了我的手，我记住了。
lines.en: Silver burns through my hand, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我退到王座边，扶着扶手站稳。
lines.en: I retreat to the throne and steady myself on the armrest.

lines.zh: 疼得不算重，但很没礼貌。
lines.en: The pain is slight; the manners are worse.

lines.zh: 你们人多，我才挨了这一下。
lines.en: You are many; that is why I took this hit.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，它正在愈合。
lines.en: I look at the wound, and it is closing.

lines.zh: 我的戒指碎了，那是族里的旧物。
lines.en: My ring shattered; it was an old family piece.

lines.zh: 三百年来，第一次有人打中我。
lines.en: In three hundred years, someone finally landed a hit.

lines.zh: 你划破手指，我的杯子就空了。
lines.en: You cut your finger, and my cup runs empty.

lines.zh: 那桶血放在台阶上，是谁的礼物？
lines.en: That barrel of blood on the steps: whose gift?

lines.zh: 我已三百年没尝过活人的血。
lines.en: Three hundred years since I tasted living blood.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起登基那晚。
lines.en: This smell recalls the night I took the throne.

lines.zh: 你手腕上的伤口，隔着门我都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell the cut on your wrist through the door.

lines.zh: 别把血瓶晃来晃去，我脾气不好。
lines.en: Stop waving that vial; my temper is short.

lines.zh: 我本想留你说话，现在只想咬你。
lines.en: I meant to talk, and now I only want to bite.

lines.zh: 这血里有药味，是谁动过手脚？
lines.en: This blood tastes of herbs. Who tampered with it?

lines.zh: 一杯就够，我不贪。
lines.en: One cup is enough; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 你把袖子卷起来，太不懂规矩。
lines.en: Rolling up your sleeve is very poor manners.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的披风，差点被裹住。
lines.en: You hit my cape and nearly got wrapped in it.

lines.zh: 没人敢撞我，你是第一个。
lines.en: No one dares bump me. You are the first.

lines.zh: 我扶住你，只是想闻清楚一点。
lines.en: I steady you only to smell you better.

lines.zh: 退开，我的戒指会割伤你。
lines.en: Step back; my ring will cut you.

lines.zh: 你撞得我杯子洒了半杯。
lines.en: You made me spill half my cup.

lines.zh: 我的骨头比门框硬，疼的是你。
lines.en: My bones are harder than the door frame; you feel it.

lines.zh: 别碰我的腰带，那上面是族徽。
lines.en: Do not touch my belt; the family crest is there.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，像来献血的。
lines.en: You fall into my arms like a blood offering.

lines.zh: 我侧身一步，今晚不想弄脏披风。
lines.en: I step aside; I would rather not stain my cape tonight.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就当你是挑衅。
lines.en: Once more and I will call it a challenge.

lines.zh: 我的新娘在三百年前就化成灰了。
lines.en: My bride turned to ash three hundred years ago.

lines.zh: 血亲之间不结盟，只论血统。
lines.en: My kind do not marry; we rank by bloodline.

lines.zh: 你想要城堡，还是想要尖牙？
lines.en: Do you want the castle, or the fangs?

lines.zh: 我试过爱人，她怕黑，跑了。
lines.en: I tried to love once; she feared the dark and fled.

lines.zh: 永生的婚约，比诅咒还长。
lines.en: An eternal marriage lasts longer than a curse.

lines.zh: 我的继承人得先杀一个同类。
lines.en: My heir must first kill one of our kind.

lines.zh: 别向我求婚，我只会给你一滴血。
lines.en: Do not propose; all I give is a drop of blood.

lines.zh: 王座旁边那个位置，空了三百年。
lines.en: The seat beside my throne has stood empty three centuries.

lines.zh: 我娶过领地，不是娶过人。
lines.en: I married a domain, not a person.

lines.zh: 你若答应，就得先死一次。
lines.en: If you agree, you must die once first.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起那颗牙，是我自己的。
lines.en: I stoop to pick up the fang, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 地上那瓶血摔碎了，我盯了很久。
lines.en: The vial on the floor shattered; I stare at it a while.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚银币，指尖立刻发黑。
lines.en: I pick up a silver coin and my fingertip blackens.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的地图卷起来，村子还在上面。
lines.en: I roll up the fallen map; the village is still on it.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指是我的族徽，谁掉的？
lines.en: This ring bears my crest. Who dropped it?

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断掉的木桩，笑了。
lines.en: I pick up a broken stake and smile.

lines.zh: 我把死者的护符收进袖子里。
lines.en: I tuck the dead man's amulet into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 地上有封信，写着我的名字。
lines.en: A letter on the floor bears my name.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块骨头，放回王座脚下。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and return it to the throne's foot.

lines.zh: 那半瓶血我留着，赏给仆人。
lines.en: I keep the half vial as a reward for a servant.

lines.zh: 村子今晚点了灯，太亮了。
lines.en: The village lit its lamps tonight. Too bright.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，也闻到了铁。
lines.en: I smell blood, and I smell iron.

lines.zh: 有人闯进我的墓园，踩了我的花。
lines.en: Someone entered my graveyard and trampled my flowers.

lines.zh: 那个猎人带着木桩，先杀他。
lines.en: That hunter carries stakes; kill him first.

lines.zh: 我的仆人被砍了，我要一个交代。
lines.en: My servant was cut down; I want an accounting.

lines.zh: 窗外的火把连成一条线。
lines.en: Torches outside form a line.

lines.zh: 领地里出现了银，得清干净。
lines.en: Silver has appeared in my domain; it must be cleansed.

lines.zh: 他们抬着圣水来了，胆子不小。
lines.en: They come carrying holy water. Bold.

lines.zh: 那只蝙蝠回来报信，说有三个人。
lines.en: A bat returns with word of three intruders.

lines.zh: 我听见钟声，猎人聚在教堂。
lines.en: I hear the bell; hunters gather at the church.

lines.zh: 这是挑衅，我要亲自去。
lines.en: This is a provocation; I will go myself.

lines.zh: 有人在我的血池里下了药。
lines.en: Someone drugged my blood pool.

lines.zh: 地板上有蒜皮，他们进过地窖。
lines.en: Garlic skins on the floor; they were in the cellar.

lines.zh: 我认得那枚护符，是旧仇家的。
lines.en: I know that amulet; it belonged to an old enemy.

lines.zh: 猎人的狗在门外叫，我听见了。
lines.en: The hunters' hounds bark outside my gate; I hear them.

lines.zh: 村里的铁匠多打了一批银钉。
lines.en: The village smith has forged a new batch of silver nails.

lines.zh: 楼梯上有血，不是我的。
lines.en: There is blood on the stairs, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 他们把窗子钉死了，想困住我。
lines.en: They have nailed the windows shut, hoping to trap me.

lines.zh: 我站在台阶上，让他们抬头看我。
lines.en: I stand on the steps and make them look up.

lines.zh: 我的披风一展，厅里的火都暗了。
lines.en: My cape spreads, and the hall's fires dim.

lines.zh: 他握着十字，指节全白了。
lines.en: He grips the cross until his knuckles whiten.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，他们就退成一团。
lines.en: I take one step; they bunch and retreat.

lines.zh: 血池在我身后翻了一下。
lines.en: The blood pool stirs behind me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，蝙蝠从梁上落下来。
lines.en: I raise a hand, and bats drop from the beams.

lines.zh: 我在等他先动，我不急。
lines.en: I wait for him to move first; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 那个年轻的在发抖，我看得清。
lines.en: The young one trembles, and I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 他们堵住门口，以为我只会走门。
lines.en: They block the door, thinking I only use doors.

lines.zh: 我把杯子放下，这表示要认真了。
lines.en: I set down my cup, which means I am serious.

lines.zh: 银的味道越来越近，我数着步子。
lines.en: The smell of silver nears; I count the steps.

lines.zh: 我说一句话，他们就退半步。
lines.en: I speak one sentence and they retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，我的眼睛还亮着。
lines.en: The lamps die, and my eyes stay lit.

lines.zh: 我指向最前面的那个，就是他了。
lines.en: I point at the one in front; he is the one.

lines.zh: 我数他们的人头，一共四个。
lines.en: I count their heads: four in all.

lines.zh: 我的影子先爬上墙，比我先到。
lines.en: My shadow climbs the wall before I do.

lines.zh: 他退到蜡烛旁，光会碍他的眼。
lines.en: He backs toward the candle; the light will blind him.

lines.zh: 我把手指在唇上一竖，没人敢说话。
lines.en: I raise a finger to my lips, and no one dares speak.

lines.zh: 我闻出最年轻那个的血最甜。
lines.en: I smell that the youngest has the sweetest blood.

lines.zh: 他的剑尖抖了一下，我看见。
lines.en: His blade tip trembles once; I see it.

lines.zh: 我一把抓住他的脖子，提离地面。
lines.en: I seize his throat and lift him off the floor.

lines.zh: 我的爪子穿过锁甲，像穿过纸。
lines.en: My claws pass through mail as if through paper.

lines.zh: 他砍我的肩，我笑了，还他一口。
lines.en: He cuts my shoulder; I laugh and bite back.

lines.zh: 我把他摔在石柱上，柱子裂了。
lines.en: I hurl him into the pillar, and the pillar cracks.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，血直接进了喉咙。
lines.en: I bite down, and blood runs straight down my throat.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩碎他掉落的木桩。
lines.en: I crush his fallen stake under one boot.

lines.zh: 他举圣水，我抓住他的手腕。
lines.en: He raises holy water; I seize his wrist.

lines.zh: 我的披风卷住他，他动不了。
lines.en: My cape wraps him, and he cannot move.

lines.zh: 我撕开他的护符，银屑落了一地。
lines.en: I tear off his amulet; silver flakes scatter.

lines.zh: 他还有力气，我就再打一次。
lines.en: He still has strength, so I strike again.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在他胸口，声音很闷。
lines.en: I drive a fist into his chest with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 他退到血池边，正好。
lines.en: He backs to the blood pool. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我把他的剑折成两段。
lines.en: I snap his sword into two pieces.

lines.zh: 最后一击，我慢慢来。
lines.en: For the last blow, I take my time.

lines.zh: 我把他的盾连手臂一起拧过来。
lines.en: I twist his shield, arm and all, out of place.

lines.zh: 我的指甲刮过他的脸，很轻。
lines.en: My nails rake his face, lightly.

lines.zh: 王座厅的门自己开了，我坐在里面。
lines.en: The throne room doors open; I am already seated.

lines.zh: 我从血池里站起来，池水顺着披风滴。
lines.en: I rise from the blood pool, it dripping from my cape.

lines.zh: 蝙蝠先涌出来，然后是我。
lines.en: The bats pour out first, and then I do.

lines.zh: 城堡的钟自己响了一下，我醒了。
lines.en: The castle bell rings once on its own; I wake.

lines.zh: 我走下长长的石阶，火把依次亮起。
lines.en: I descend the long stairs, and torches light in turn.

lines.zh: 雾漫进村子，我站在雾中间。
lines.en: Fog rolls into the village, and I stand within it.

lines.zh: 他们挖开我的墓，我就出来了。
lines.en: They opened my tomb, so I came out.

lines.zh: 月亮照到塔顶时，我睁开眼。
lines.en: When moonlight reaches the tower top, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从窗口落下，落在他们中间。
lines.en: I drop from the window and land among them.

lines.zh: 地毯上多了一道影子，那就是我。
lines.en: A new shadow crosses the carpet. That is me.

lines.zh: 我推开棺盖，闻到了夜风。
lines.en: I push off the coffin lid and smell the night wind.

lines.zh: 领地边界有人越线，我亲自来了。
lines.en: Someone crossed my border, so I came myself.

lines.zh: 血仆跪了一地，我从中走过。
lines.en: Blood servants kneel everywhere as I walk through.

lines.zh: 钟楼上的旗子换了方向，我到了。
lines.en: The flag on the tower turns; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 棺材里的土还是新的，我拍掉了。
lines.en: The soil in my coffin was still fresh; I brushed it off.

lines.zh: 我的仆人吹灭了最后一支蜡烛。
lines.en: My servant snuffs out the last candle.

lines.zh: 塔上的蝙蝠一齐飞起，替我让路。
lines.en: The bats on the tower rise together and make way for me.

lines.zh: 我从镜子里走出来，镜面没有裂。
lines.en: I step out of the mirror; its surface does not crack.

lines.zh: 半夜的雾从墓园的缺口漫进来。
lines.en: Midnight fog seeps through the gap in the graveyard wall.

lines.zh: 我落地时，披风先垂到地面。
lines.en: When I land, my cloak reaches the floor first.

lines.zh: 火烧到披风，我把它整个撕下来。
lines.en: Fire catches my cape; I tear the whole thing off.

lines.zh: 我从塔阶上摔下去，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I fall down the tower stairs, and a bone cracks.

lines.zh: 血池把我吞了半截，我爬出来。
lines.en: The blood pool swallows me halfway; I climb out.

lines.zh: 爆炸震落了吊灯，砸在我肩上。
lines.en: The blast drops the chandelier onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 弩箭插进胸口，我拔出来咬断。
lines.en: A bolt pierces my chest; I pull it out and bite it apart.

lines.zh: 圣光钻进骨头，我的手指僵了。
lines.en: Holy light seeps into my bones, and my fingers stiffen.

lines.zh: 我已经七天没喝血，站不稳。
lines.en: Seven days without blood, and I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 雷击穿过塔顶，我的披风烧了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tower top and burns my cape.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有血，也没有王座。
lines.en: The void holds no blood and no throne.
